pairs.target: " huíláng shàng děng . "
pairs.english: “Back to the gallery to wait,”
pairs.hanzi: “回廊上等。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu shuō .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou said.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟说。

pairs.target: lín zhào gēnzhe zhuǎnshēn , zǒuchū duàn gǒng shí , háishì rěnbúzhù huítóu kàn le yìyǎn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao turned with the others; as she walked out of the broken arch, she still couldn’t help looking back once.
pairs.hanzi: 林照跟着转身，走出断拱时，还是忍不住回头看了一眼。

pairs.target: téng yè yǐjīng chuí huíqù , bǎ nà dào hēi fèng zhēzhù le .
pairs.english: The vine leaves had already drooped back, leaving that dark fissure screened.
pairs.hanzi: 藤叶已经垂回去，把那道黑缝遮住了。

pairs.target: shào píng bǎ shōu hǎo de shéng fàngzài zhuàn táishàng , jiàn tā huílái , xiān zhǐ le zhǐ bèi jià .
pairs.english: Shao Ping set the coiled ropes on the landing; seeing her return, he first pointed at the pack frame.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平把收好的绳放在转台上，见她回来，先指了指背架。

pairs.target: " zhè fù qīng xiē .
pairs.english: “This frame's lighter.
pairs.hanzi: “这副轻些。

pairs.target: nǐ biédòng , děng wǒ chóng kǔn . "
pairs.english: Don’t move; wait for me to lash it again.”
pairs.hanzi: 你别动，等我重捆。”

pairs.target: xièxiàlái de dōngxī fēn le liǎngduī .
pairs.english: The unloaded things were divided into two piles.
pairs.hanzi: 卸下来的东西分了两堆。

pairs.target: shǎo le héngmù de bèi jià zhī zhuāng pūgài hé jǐjiàn qīng wù ,
pairs.english: The frame that was missing its crossbar held only bedding and a few light things;
pairs.hanzi: 少了横木的背架只装铺盖和几件轻物，

pairs.target: shào píng jiāng duǎnshéng cóng mù yǎnlǐ chuān guòqù , wǎng liǎngcè bēngjǐn , yāzhù yuánxiān róngyì sànkāi de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Shao Ping threaded short cord through the mortises, pulled it taut toward both sides, and braced the part that had tended to come apart.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平将短绳从木眼里穿过去，往两侧绷紧，压住原先容易散开的地方。

pairs.target: tóngguō hé zhòng xiē de shuǐnáng nuó dào lìng yífù shàng .
pairs.english: The copper pot and the heavier waterskins were moved to the other frame.
pairs.hanzi: 铜锅和重些的水囊挪到另一副上。

pairs.target: dùhéng jiēguò nà fù zhòng jià , wǎng jiānshàng yì tí , shào píng máng fú zhe xiàmiàn , méi ràng guō zhuàngqiáng .
pairs.english: Du Heng took the heavy frame and hoisted it onto his shoulder; Shao Ping quickly steadied it from below, keeping the pot from striking the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡接过那副重架，往肩上一提，邵平忙扶着下面，没让锅撞墙。

pairs.target: lín zhào ná hǎo zìjǐ de xiǎo shuǐnáng , gēn zài wēn shù hòutou .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao picked up her own small waterskin and followed behind Wen Shu.
pairs.hanzi: 林照拿好自己的小水囊，跟在温述后头。

pairs.target: shàng jiē shí tā zhī fú le fú qiáng , zhǎngxīn biàn yòu téng qǐlái , zhǐhǎo bǎshǒu tiē zài xiōngqián .
pairs.english: On the way up the steps she only steadied herself against the wall, but then her palm began to hurt again; she had to hold the hand against her chest.
pairs.hanzi: 上阶时她只扶了扶墙，掌心便又疼起来，只好把手贴在胸前。

pairs.target: wēn shù zǒu jǐbù , biàn tíngxiàlái děng tā , shuí yě méi cuī .
pairs.english: Wen Shu walked a few steps, then stopped to wait for her; nobody hurried her.
pairs.hanzi: 温述走几步，便停下来等她，谁也没催。

pairs.target: huídào zuóyè xiēsù de shímén nèi , shào píng cái bǎ shèngyú de shéng jù tānkāi .
pairs.english: Only back inside the stone doorway where they'd slept last night did Shao Ping spread out the remaining rope gear.
pairs.hanzi: 回到昨夜歇宿的石门内，邵平才把剩余的绳具摊开。

pairs.target: tā jiāng liǎngfù diàosuǒ chóngxīn fēngěi shěn yàn zhōu hé dùhéng , yòu ná zìjǐ de nà fù bèi jià shì zhe bèi le yìhuí , shǒu cóng liǎngbiān mō guò jié kòu , cái xièxiàlái .
pairs.english: He handed the two hauling-line sets back to Shen Yanzhou and Du Heng, then tried shouldering his own pack frame once, feeling the knots on both sides with his hands before setting it down.
pairs.hanzi: 他将两副吊索重新分给沈砚舟和杜衡，又拿自己的那副背架试着背了一回，手从两边摸过结扣，才卸下来。

pairs.target: duàndiào de bànjié jiàn yě dàishànglái le , qī lán yòngbù yì guǒ , sāijìn náng cè .
pairs.english: The broken half-arrow had been brought up too; Qi Lan wrapped it in cloth and tucked it into the side of her quiver.
pairs.hanzi: 断掉的半截箭也带上来了，戚岚用布一裹，塞进囊侧。

pairs.target: lín zhào zuòzài pūgài shàng , zhōngyú hē dào le shuǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao sat on the bedding and finally got a drink of water.
pairs.hanzi: 林照坐在铺盖上，终于喝到了水。

pairs.target: shuǐ yǐ bù liáng , yànxiàqù shí , hóulóng lǐ nà céng gānsè cái mànmàn sōngkāi .
pairs.english: The water was no longer cold; as she swallowed, the layer of dryness in her throat slowly began to ease.
pairs.hanzi: 水已不凉，咽下去时，喉咙里那层干涩才慢慢松开。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng bǎ shuǐ nánggài nǐngjǐn , yìzhī shǒu zǒng duì bùzhǔn , shào píng shēnshǒu jiēguò qù , tì tā nǐng hǎo .
pairs.english: She tried to screw the waterskin cap shut, but one hand kept missing the thread; Shao Ping reached over, took it and tightened it for her.
pairs.hanzi: 她想把水囊盖拧紧，一只手总对不准，邵平伸手接过去，替她拧好。

pairs.target: " hái dé děng duōjiǔ ? "
pairs.english: “How much longer do we have to wait?”
pairs.hanzi: “还得等多久？”

pairs.target: tā wèn .
pairs.english: she asked.
pairs.hanzi: 她问。

pairs.target: " tóuyìhuí jí , wǎnghòu yě jí . "
pairs.english: “You are impatient the first time, and will still be impatient after that.”
pairs.hanzi: “头一回急，往后也急。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ shuǐnáng dìhuílái , " shòu néng yòu bù tīng rén cuī . "
pairs.english: He handed the waterskin back. “The bestowal pays no heed to being hurried.”
pairs.hanzi: 他把水囊递回来，“授能又不听人催。”

pairs.target: tā dītóu kàn zìjǐ de shǒu .
pairs.english: She lowered her head to look at her own hand.
pairs.hanzi: 她低头看自己的手。

pairs.target: bù shàng méiyǒu zài yīn chū hóng lái , lǐmiàn què yízhènyizhèn dì tiào .
pairs.english: No more red had seeped through the cloth, but beneath it came pulse after pulse of throbbing.
pairs.hanzi: 布上没有再洇出红来，里面却一阵一阵地跳。

pairs.target: shòu néng huì shì shénmeyàng , tā xiǎng bù chūlái .
pairs.english: She couldn't imagine what the bestowal would be like.
pairs.hanzi: 授能会是什么样，她想不出来。

pairs.target: fāngcái nà yìdiǎn guāngshōu méi le , jiànjiān shàng shénme yě méi liúxià , dǎo shì tā nà jù " jiàn bǎo lǐ yě xiě shàng ", yìzhí qīngqīngchǔchǔ dì liúzài ěrbiān .
pairs.english: The speck of light had just contracted out of sight, leaving nothing on the sword tip; instead, his words, “Put it in the references too,” always remained in her ears, perfectly clear.
pairs.hanzi: 方才那一点光收没了，剑尖上什么也没留下，倒是他那句“荐保里也写上”，一直清清楚楚地留在耳边。

pairs.target: xǔ cén zài ménkǒu zhǎnkāi túzhǐ , yā zhe zhǐ jiǎo , xiàng shěn yàn zhōu shuō le jǐjù .
pairs.english: Xu Cen spread out the map at the doorway, held down a corner and said a few words to Shen Yanzhou.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑在门口展开图纸，压着纸角，向沈砚舟说了几句。

pairs.target: lín zhào zhī tīngjiàn " shàngtóu nà dào zhǎi kǒu ".
pairs.english: Lin Zhao caught only “the narrow gap up above.”
pairs.hanzi: 林照只听见“上头那道窄口”。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu guòqù kàn le yíhuìer , jiào qī lán péi tā zǒu yítàng .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou went over to look for a while, then asked Qi Lan to go with her.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟过去看了一会儿，叫戚岚陪她走一趟。

pairs.target: " chá dào dìèrdào duàn qiáng jiù huílái .
pairs.english: “Check as far as the second broken wall, then come back.
pairs.hanzi: “查到第二道断墙就回来。

pairs.target: zuówǎn guò bèi jià de dìfāng , zài shì yíbiàn . "
pairs.english: Test once more the place where we passed the frames through last night.”
pairs.hanzi: 昨晚过背架的地方，再试一遍。”

pairs.target: qī lán wǎng lín zhào zhèbiān sǎo le yìyǎn , qǔ qǐ gōng , gēnzhe xǔ cén chūlemén .
pairs.english: Qi Lan swept a glance toward where Lin Zhao stood, picked up her bow and followed Xu Cen out.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚往林照这边扫了一眼，取起弓，跟着许岑出了门。

pairs.target: dùhéng jiāng dùn fàngzài shǒubiān , zuò dào ménnèi , wēn shù dūn zài tā pángbiān kàn nà zhī xiānqián fā jiāng de shǒu .
pairs.english: Du Heng set the shield within reach and sat inside the doorway; Wen Shu crouched there beside him to examine the hand that had stiffened earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡将盾放在手边，坐到门内，温述蹲在他旁边看那只先前发僵的手。

pairs.target: shào píng tiāochū yì jié mómáo de shéng tóu , jiào lín zhào bǎ xiǎodāo dìgěi tā .
pairs.english: Shao Ping picked out a length of frayed rope end and asked Lin Zhao to hand him the small knife.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平挑出一截磨毛的绳头，叫林照把小刀递给他。

pairs.target: tā chàdiǎn yòu yòng shāng shǒu qù ná , shēn dào yíbàn , huàn le lìngyìzhī .
pairs.english: She almost reached for it with her injured hand again, then switched to the other midway through the reach.
pairs.hanzi: 她差点又用伤手去拿，伸到一半，换了另一只。

pairs.target: shào píng kànjiàn , méi xiào .
pairs.english: Shao Ping saw, but didn't smile.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平看见，没笑。

pairs.target: láng wài de yǔ tíng le .
pairs.english: The rain outside the gallery had stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 廊外的雨停了。

pairs.target: shuǐ réng cóng xiàmiàn guò , tīng zhe búzài xiàng gé le yìcéng dōngxī .
pairs.english: Water still passed below, no longer sounding as though a barrier lay between her and it.
pairs.hanzi: 水仍从下面过，听着不再像隔了一层东西。

pairs.target: lín zhào kàoqiáng xiē le xǔjiǔ , děng tuǐ shàng de suān zhàng huǎn xiàlái , cái xiǎngqǐ nà bànkuài bǐng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao rested against the wall for a long while; only when the aching heaviness in her legs eased did she remember the half-flatbread.
pairs.hanzi: 林照靠墙歇了许久，等腿上的酸胀缓下来，才想起那半块饼。

pairs.target: tā jiěkāi yāodài , bāi le yìdiǎn , mànmàn jiáo zhe , bǎ shèng de hé bù , dòuzǐ yìqǐ shōuhuí qù .
pairs.english: She untied her waist pouch, broke off a little and chewed slowly, then put the rest away together with the cloth and beans.
pairs.hanzi: 她解开腰袋，掰了一点，慢慢嚼着，把剩的和布、豆子一起收回去。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu zài tā miànqián tíngxià .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou stopped in front of her.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟在她面前停下。

pairs.target: " néng zǒu me ? "
pairs.english: “Can you walk at all?”
pairs.hanzi: “能走么？”

pairs.target: tā yànxià kǒulǐ de bǐng , zhàn qǐlái .
pairs.english: She swallowed the flatbread in her mouth and stood up.
pairs.hanzi: 她咽下口里的饼，站起来。

pairs.target: " jiàn bǎo de shì , yǒu jǐjù wèn nǐ .
pairs.english: “There are a few questions to ask you about the reference.
pairs.hanzi: “荐保的事，有几句问你。

pairs.target: guòlái yìdiǎn . "
pairs.english: Come over a little way.”
pairs.hanzi: 过来一点。”

pairs.target: tā cháo shí ménwài piān le piāntóu .
pairs.english: He tilted his head toward the outside of the stone doorway.
pairs.hanzi: 他朝石门外偏了偏头。

pairs.target: lín zhào bǎ shuǐnáng guàhuí yāojiān , jīngguò shào píng shēnbiān , tīngjiàn dāorèn guāguò shéng pí , shāshā dì xiǎng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao hung the waterskin back at her waist; passing beside Shao Ping, she heard the blade rasp softly over the rope’s outer fibers.
pairs.hanzi: 林照把水囊挂回腰间，经过邵平身边，听见刀刃刮过绳皮，沙沙地响。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng wèn jiàn bǎo shàng shìbushì hái dé fāng guǎnshì qiān rèn , yòu juéde tā jìrán kěn xiě , zǒng búhuì lòudiào .
pairs.english: She wanted to ask whether Steward Fang would also have to countersign the reference, then thought that since he was willing to write it, surely he wouldn’t overlook that.
pairs.hanzi: 她想问荐保上是不是还得方管事签认，又觉得他既然肯写，总不会漏掉。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu yán nèiqiáng wǎngyòu zǒu , ràoguò yídào zhéjiǎo .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou went right along the inner wall and rounded a corner.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟沿内墙往右走，绕过一道折角。

pairs.target: zhèlǐ réng yǒu láng dǐng , lí zuóyè lán shéng de duàn lán yǐjīng gékāi yíduàn .
pairs.english: Here the gallery still had its roof; it was already separated by some distance from the broken railing roped off last night.
pairs.hanzi: 这里仍有廊顶，离昨夜拦绳的断栏已经隔开一段。

pairs.target: kào wài de bàn qiángshàng kāi zhe shí chuāng , chuāng xià què tā le gè kǒuzǐ , pángbiān de lù hái kuān , néngróng liǎnggè rén cuò shēn .
pairs.english: Stone windows opened in the outer half-wall, but a gap had collapsed beneath one; the path beside it was still wide enough for two people to pass each other.
pairs.hanzi: 靠外的半墙上开着石窗，窗下却塌了个口子，旁边的路还宽，能容两个人错身。

pairs.target: lín zhào méiyǒu kào guòqù , zhàn zàinèi qiángbiān .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao did not go near it, but stood by the inner wall.
pairs.hanzi: 林照没有靠过去，站在内墙边。

pairs.target: " jiālǐ háiyǒu shuí ? "
pairs.english: “Who else is at home?”
pairs.hanzi: “家里还有谁？”

pairs.target: tā wèn .
pairs.english: he asked.
pairs.hanzi: 他问。

pairs.target: " zhōu shěn .
pairs.english: “Aunt Zhou.
pairs.hanzi: “周婶。

pairs.target: tā zài huòzhàn zuòshì . "
pairs.english: She works at a freight depot.”
pairs.hanzi: 她在货栈做事。”

pairs.target: " lǐng le pái , wǎnghòu hái zǒu dìgōng ? "
pairs.english: “Once you get your license, will you keep taking dungeon work afterward?”
pairs.hanzi: “领了牌，往后还走地宫？”

pairs.target: " yě jiē biéde huó .
pairs.english: “I take other work too.
pairs.hanzi: “也接别的活。

pairs.target: néng zìjǐ tiāo , jiù búyòng zǒng děng rén jiào . "
pairs.english: If I can choose for myself, I won't always have to wait for someone to call me.”
pairs.hanzi: 能自己挑，就不用总等人叫。”

pairs.target: tā diǎn le diǎntóu , wǎngqián yòu zǒu liǎngbù , cóng shí chuāng páng cháo xià kàn .
pairs.english: He nodded, then went two steps farther and looked down from beside the stone window.
pairs.hanzi: 他点了点头，往前又走两步，从石窗旁朝下看。

pairs.target: lín zhào shùnzhe wàngqù , xiàmiàn yídào shuǐcáo tiēzhe qiáng xié xiàqù , dào le bàntú , bèi jǐkuài wāixié de shíbǎn zhēzhù .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao followed his gaze; below, a water channel sloped down along the wall, covered halfway along by several crooked slabs.
pairs.hanzi: 林照顺着望去，下面一道水槽贴着墙斜下去，到了半途，被几块歪斜的石板遮住。

pairs.target: shuǐshēng zài shíbǎn dǐxià zhuǎn le gè wān , tīngbújiàn luòdào nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: The sound of water turned a corner down below the slabs; she couldn’t hear where it fell.
pairs.hanzi: 水声在石板底下转了个弯，听不见落到哪里。

pairs.target: " nǐ jīnrì kàn dé hěn zhǔn . "
pairs.english: “You read things very well today,”
pairs.hanzi: “你今日看得很准。”

pairs.target: tā shuō .
pairs.english: he said.
pairs.hanzi: 他说。

pairs.target: lín zhào shōuhuí mùguāng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao drew her gaze back.
pairs.hanzi: 林照收回目光。

pairs.target: " shào shīfu yě ——"
pairs.english: “Master Shao also—”
pairs.hanzi: “邵师傅也——”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . "
pairs.english: “I know.”
pairs.hanzi: “我知道。”

pairs.target: tā huíguò shēn , kànzhe tā , piànkè méiyǒu shuōhuà .
pairs.english: He turned around and looked at her, saying nothing for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 他回过身，看着她，片刻没有说话。

pairs.target: lín zhào gāngcái méi wèn chūkǒu de nà jù , hūrán yě wèn bù chūlái le .
pairs.english: Suddenly Lin Zhao could no longer put into words the question she had held back earlier either.
pairs.hanzi: 林照刚才没问出口的那句，忽然也问不出来了。

pairs.target: " nǐ yě zài děng shòu néng . "
pairs.english: “You are waiting for the bestowal too.”
pairs.hanzi: “你也在等授能。”

pairs.target: tā zhēng le yíxià , diǎntóu .
pairs.english: She froze for a moment, then nodded.
pairs.hanzi: 她怔了一下，点头。

pairs.target: " wǒ bùnéng zài děng xià yítàng le . "
pairs.english: “I can no longer wait for the next expedition.”
pairs.hanzi: “我不能再等下一趟了。”

pairs.target: lín zhào bù míngbái zhè jù huà hé zìjǐ yǒu shénme guānxì .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao didn’t understand what this remark had to do with her.
pairs.hanzi: 林照不明白这句话和自己有什么关系。

pairs.target: tā cháo láishí de zhéjiǎo kàn qù , shěn yàn zhōu yǐjīng shēnshǒu , wòzhù tā méi shòushāng de nàtiáo gēbo .
pairs.english: She looked toward the corner they’d come around, but Shen Yanzhou had already reached out and gripped her uninjured arm.
pairs.hanzi: 她朝来时的折角看去，沈砚舟已经伸手，握住她没受伤的那条胳膊。

pairs.target: " gōngzǐ ? "
pairs.english: “Young master?”
pairs.hanzi: “公子？”

pairs.target: " jiālǐ hái zài zhēng .
pairs.english: “They are still arguing at home.
pairs.hanzi: “家里还在争。

pairs.target: huàn yífèn qì , tāmen dōu bùkěn .
pairs.english: They won’t even agree to change a single contract.
pairs.hanzi: 换一份契，他们都不肯。

pairs.target: ruò wǒ shuōhuà néng zài duōyífèn fènliàng ……"
pairs.english: If my words could carry just a little more weight…”
pairs.hanzi: 若我说话能再多一份分量……”

pairs.target: tā wò dé hěn jǐn .
pairs.english: His grip was very tight.
pairs.hanzi: 他握得很紧。

pairs.target: tā wǎnghuí chōu le yíxià , méiyǒu chōudòng .
pairs.english: She tried pulling back once, but couldn't move her arm.
pairs.hanzi: 她往回抽了一下，没有抽动。

pairs.target: " jīnrì ruò méiyǒu nǐ , dùhéng wèibì zhàndézhù .
pairs.english: “Without you today, Du Heng might not have held his ground.
pairs.hanzi: “今日若没有你，杜衡未必站得住。

pairs.target: wǒ zhīdào . "
pairs.english: I know.”
pairs.hanzi: 我知道。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé bǐ fāngcái kuài , " kě nà yífèn ruò luò zài wǒ shēnshàng , wǎnghòu néng gǎi de , jiù bùzhǐ nǐ zhè yìzhāng jiàn bǎo . "
pairs.english: He was speaking faster than before. “But if that share fell to me personally, what I could change in the future would be more than just this one reference of yours.”
pairs.hanzi: 他说得比方才快，“可那一份若落在我身上，往后能改的，就不止你这一张荐保。”

pairs.target: lín zhào de jiǎo wǎng hòutuì , xiégēn pèngshàng qiánggēn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao moved her feet back, her heel striking the foot of the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 林照的脚往后退，鞋跟碰上墙根。

pairs.target: tā zhè cái fājué , tā yìzhí zài kàn tā de liǎn , xiàng zài děng tā dāying shénme .
pairs.english: Only then did she realize he had been watching her face all along, as though waiting for her to agree to something.
pairs.hanzi: 她这才发觉，他一直在看她的脸，像在等她答应什么。

pairs.target: " jiàn bǎo wǒ búyào le . "
pairs.english: “I don't want the reference anymore.”
pairs.hanzi: “荐保我不要了。”

pairs.target: " búshì zhège . "
pairs.english: “That isn’t it.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是这个。”

pairs.target: tā yáotóu , " nǐ bù míngbái .
pairs.english: He shook his head. “You don't understand.
pairs.hanzi: 他摇头，“你不明白。

pairs.target: búshì wǒ gěi nǐ duōshǎo ——"
pairs.english: It isn't about how much I give you—”
pairs.hanzi: 不是我给你多少——”

pairs.target: " wǒ huíqù děng . "
pairs.english: “I will go back and wait,”
pairs.hanzi: “我回去等。”

pairs.target: tā shuō .
pairs.english: she said.
pairs.hanzi: 她说。

pairs.target: tā měngdì zhuǎnshēn , cháo zhéjiǎo hǎn le yìshēng " shào shīfu ", gēbo què bèi zhuài le huílái .
pairs.english: She turned sharply and called “Master Shao” once toward the corner, but her arm was yanked back.
pairs.hanzi: 她猛地转身，朝折角喊了一声“邵师傅”，胳膊却被拽了回来。

pairs.target: hòubèi líkāi nèiqiáng , tā liàngqiàng zhe zhuàng xiàng bàn qiáng de tā kǒu .
pairs.english: Her back left the inner wall; she stumbled toward the gap in the half-wall.
pairs.hanzi: 后背离开内墙，她踉跄着撞向半墙的塌口。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu lìngyìzhī shǒu yǐjīng dǐzhù tā jiāntóu .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou's other hand was already pressed against her shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟另一只手已经抵住她肩头。

pairs.target: " zhōu shěn nàbiān , wǒhuì zhàokàn . "
pairs.english: “As for Aunt Zhou, I will look after her.”
pairs.hanzi: “周婶那边，我会照看。”

pairs.target: lín zhào táiqǐ bāo zhe bù de shǒu , zhuāzhù tā de xiùkǒu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao raised the hand bandaged with cloth and caught his sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 林照抬起包着布的手，抓住他的袖口。

pairs.target: bù cèng guò yīliào , tā xiǎng bǎ nà jǐgè zì zài hǎn yíbiàn , xiōngkǒu què xiān āi le yíxià tuīlì .
pairs.english: The cloth scraped against his clothing; she wanted to shout those few words once more, but first a shove struck her chest.
pairs.hanzi: 布蹭过衣料，她想把那几个字再喊一遍，胸口却先挨了一下推力。

pairs.target: jiǎoxià hūrán méiyǒu le shítou .
pairs.english: Suddenly there was no stone under her feet.
pairs.hanzi: 脚下忽然没有了石头。

pairs.target: tā zhuàng shàng xié qì de qiángmiàn , xītóu cāguòqù , shēntǐ wǎng xiàhuá .
pairs.english: She struck the sloping masonry, her knees scraped past, and her body slid downward.
pairs.hanzi: 她撞上斜砌的墙面，膝头擦过去，身体往下滑。

pairs.target: zhǐjiān zài shī fènglǐ zhuā le yíxià , zhī kōu xià yìdiǎn suì ní .
pairs.english: Her fingertips clawed once at a wet joint, scraping out only a little crumbled mud.
pairs.hanzi: 指尖在湿缝里抓了一下，只抠下一点碎泥。

pairs.target: tóudǐng de huī guāng bèi shēnchū de shíbǎn jiéduàn , tā hái méi láidejí quán qǐshēn , yāo cè biàn zhuàng shàng shénme , měngdì yídùn .
pairs.english: A projecting slab cut off the gray light overhead; before she could curl up, her side struck something, abruptly checking her fall.
pairs.hanzi: 头顶的灰光被伸出的石板截断，她还没来得及蜷起身，腰侧便撞上什么，猛地一顿。

pairs.target: nà dōngxī jìn dào ròu lǐ , liáng le yíshùn , suíhòu cái shì téng .
pairs.english: The thing went into her flesh, cold for an instant; only then came the pain.
pairs.hanzi: 那东西进到肉里，凉了一瞬，随后才是疼。

pairs.target: tā zhāngkāizuǐ , qì què chūbùlái .
pairs.english: She opened her mouth, but her breath would not come out.
pairs.hanzi: 她张开嘴，气却出不来。

pairs.target: yīliào bēngzhù , bǎ tā guà le piànkè , qiáng lǐ suíjí chuánchū yìshēng cuìxiǎng , shēnzi yòu luòxiàqù , zhuàngjìn bù shēn de shuǐ lǐ .
pairs.english: Her clothing pulled taut, leaving her hanging for a moment; then a sharp crack came from the wall, and her body dropped again into the shallow water.
pairs.hanzi: 衣料绷住，把她挂了片刻，墙里随即传出一声脆响，身子又落下去，撞进不深的水里。

pairs.target: shuǐ tuō búzhù tā .
pairs.english: The water couldn’t support her.
pairs.hanzi: 水托不住她。

pairs.target: jiān bèi kē guò shítou , bèi tuī zhe huáxiàng ànchù .
pairs.english: Her shoulders and back knocked against stone as she was pushed, sliding into the darkness.
pairs.hanzi: 肩背磕过石头，被推着滑向暗处。

pairs.target: tā yòng shǒu qù àn yāo cè , zhǐfèng lǐ yǒngchū yípiàn wēnrè , dào le shuǐ lǐ , què lìkè lěng le .
pairs.english: She pressed a hand to her side; a spreading warmth welled between her fingers, but turned cold immediately upon reaching the water.
pairs.hanzi: 她用手去按腰侧，指缝里涌出一片温热，到了水里，却立刻冷了。

pairs.target: shàngtóu yǒurén jiào .
pairs.english: Someone called from above.
pairs.hanzi: 上头有人叫。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng táitóu , éjiǎo yòu pèngshàng dī shí , yǎnqián hēi le yíxià .
pairs.english: She tried to lift her head, but her temple struck another low stone and her sight went black for an instant.
pairs.hanzi: 她想抬头，额角又碰上低石，眼前黑了一下。

pairs.target: shuǐ guǎiguò wān , lián nà yìdiǎn huī guāng yě dàizǒu le .
pairs.english: The water rounded a bend, taking even that last speck of gray light away.
pairs.hanzi: 水拐过弯，连那一点灰光也带走了。
